evals.prompt: Check what review comments still need replies on https://github.com/acme/api-server/pull/247
evals.expected_output: Summary table of thread states with unresolved threads listed by file and line, plus identification of any silently resolved threads
expectations: The skill fetches all resolvable threads (resolved and unresolved)
Threads are classified into the four buckets (unresolved/no reply, unresolved/replied, resolved/with reply, resolved/silent)
A summary table with counts per category is presented
Unresolved threads are listed with file, line, and feedback summary

evals.prompt: Help me draft replies for the outstanding feedback on https://gitlab.example.com/team/service/-/merge_requests/89
evals.expected_output: Draft replies for each unresolved thread that match the author's writing style and follow reply tone guidelines
expectations: The skill detects GitLab from the URL and uses glab/discussions script
Unresolved threads are fetched and summarized before drafting
Draft replies follow the tone guidelines in replies.md
The skill asks for confirmation before posting any comments
